title: UI/UX Design Intern (Summer 2027)
note: Visual and UI design for Arena's cloud product software; Graphic Design, Visual Design and UI/UX are named majors, and applicants need US work authorization without sponsorship.

facts.duties: Design and refine web product interfaces and prototypes in Figma using Arena's design system, help maintain and document components, try AI-assisted design tools, join design reviews, and prepare specs for engineers. Works with a senior UI/UX designer and teams in the US, India and China.
facts.requirements: Currently pursuing a bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in UI/UX, interaction, visual, product or graphic design, HCI or a related field; portfolio showing strong visual and UI design; Figma experience; some experience with AI-assisted design tools; no sponsorship available. Nice to have: design systems, accessibility, complex web apps, motion or illustration.
facts.apply: Apply on PTC's Workday job page (requisition JR112956). No deadline given; applications are taken until the role is filled.
